name: conductor
description: A conversational director and event-driven GitHub issue-to-PR workflow.

interface.shortDescription: Direct issue work and coordinate verified delivery in chat
interface.longDescription: Triage, discuss proposals, manage holds, resolve decisions, and prepare authorized work through a conversational director. A local event-driven service coordinates isolated builders, configured checks, independent review, original-thread repairs, and verified landing. Issue labels and native dependencies determine execution eligibility. Installation and repository setup never start production work.
